# app/controllers/api/v1/uploads_controller.rb
class Api::V1::UploadsController < ApplicationController
  skip_before_action :verify_authenticity_token
  before_action :authenticate_api_key

  UPLOAD_DIR = Rails.root.join('public', 'uploads')

  def create
    unless params[:file].present?
      return render json: { error: 'No file provided' }, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end

    uploaded_file = params[:file]
    original_filename = uploaded_file.original_filename

    # Basic extension check - allows common web formats
    allowed_extensions = %w[.jpg .jpeg .png .gif .pdf .doc .docx .svg .html .xml]
    ext = File.extname(original_filename).downcase

    unless allowed_extensions.include?(ext)
      return render json: { error: 'File type not allowed' }, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end

    # Content-Type validation
    allowed_content_types = [
      'image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/gif', 'image/svg+xml',
      'application/pdf', 'application/msword',
      'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document',
      'text/html', 'application/xml', 'text/xml'
    ]

    unless allowed_content_types.include?(uploaded_file.content_type)
      return render json: { error: 'Content type not allowed' }, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end

    # Generate storage path preserving original name for user convenience
    timestamp = Time.now.to_i
    storage_name = "#{timestamp}_#{sanitize_filename(original_filename)}"
    storage_path = UPLOAD_DIR.join(storage_name)

    # Ensure upload directory exists
    FileUtils.mkdir_p(UPLOAD_DIR)

    # Write file to disk
    File.open(storage_path, 'wb') do |f|
      f.write(uploaded_file.read)
    end

    # Store metadata
    UploadRecord.create!(
      filename: storage_name,
      original_filename: original_filename,
      content_type: uploaded_file.content_type,
      size: uploaded_file.size,
      uploaded_by: current_api_user
    )

    render json: {
      success: true,
      url: "/uploads/#{storage_name}",
      filename: storage_name,
      size: uploaded_file.size
    }, status: :created
  end

  def show
    record = UploadRecord.find_by!(filename: params[:filename])
    file_path = UPLOAD_DIR.join(record.filename)

    if File.exist?(file_path)
      # Serve with original content type for proper rendering
      send_file file_path,
        type: record.content_type,
        disposition: 'inline',
        filename: record.original_filename
    else
      render json: { error: 'File not found' }, status: :not_found
    end
  end

  private

  def sanitize_filename(filename)
    # Remove path traversal but preserve extension and name
    filename.gsub(/[\/\\]/, '').gsub(/\.\./, '')
  end

  def authenticate_api_key
    api_key = request.headers['X-API-Key']
    unless api_key.present? && ApiKey.active.exists?(key: api_key)
      render json: { error: 'Unauthorized' }, status: :unauthorized
    end
  end

  def current_api_user
    @current_api_user ||= ApiKey.find_by(key: request.headers['X-API-Key'])&.user
  end
end
